description: This file is a C header file defining secure string and memory operation macros, error handling, and related utility functions for safe C programming, particularly for the safec library. It includes external library references, macro definitions, inline functions, and conditional compilation for a dummy API.

methods.name: parseFormat
methods.description: Inline function to format a string with variable arguments, returning success status based on buffer size.

methods.name: strcmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to compare two strings safely with a maximum length, returning status and result.

methods.name: strcasecmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to compare two strings case-insensitively safely with a maximum length, returning status and result.

methods.name: memcmp_s
methods.description: Inline function to compare two memory blocks safely with a maximum size, returning status and result.
